sources.kind: Akademie-Ausgabe VIII electronic transcription, lines 23–25; page inspected
sources.observation: The relative clause locates the confinement within the walking device. The surrounding text concerns the subjects taking a step beyond it and attempting to walk alone. This is not a facsimile inspection.

interpretive_decisions: Represent one strong reading of confinement through a finite passage graph with a fixed background and a specified edge-removing restriction.
Require a route out without this restriction and no route out with it; merely being inside or already unable to move does not suffice.
Bind the restriction to an actual applying event involving a human member of the guardians, the same subject and the same containing device.
Treat the finite scope as an explicit completeness premise rather than inferring closure from missing data.
Keep this a partial figurative annotation, without adding a new literal confinement assertion or treating a device identifier as its definition.
